description: Sends a structured quote request to Onan Capital. Required: organization, name, email, and lines (description and quantity, plus unit of measure when known). Returns a reference id. A person writes the quote. Do not send unit prices.

comparableTo.description: Manufacturer number the buyer named, such as 55082 or P86984. Not an Onan SKU.

sku.description: Onan SKU from search_supplies, when one was selected.

sector.description: K-12, higher education, healthcare, senior living, or government.

sourceSystem.description: Name of the agent or suite submitting the RFQ.

name: submit_rfq
title: Submit a structured RFQ
